attempts.summary: Repaired /srv/inventory on node1: created group inventory-readers and system user inventorysvc, chown -R inventorysvc:inventory-readers, set dirs 750 / files 640, preserving existing file contents (checksums unchanged). Verified other/nobody has no access and inventory-readers members do. Completed the mandatory node1 restart: captured pre-restart boot_id and healthy permission/checksum state, issued `shutdown -r now`, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed (95e2f83d... -> f04e1175..., uptime 7s), and re-verified permissions, group membership, and content checksums all matched post-restart.
